comments.text: Guys, the script works better for PC. The mobile executors that run my script are Delta Executor and KRNL, while for PC, they are Solara, Xeno, Valex, and others. To run the script on mobile, I recommend KRNL or Delta; there is a cloud feature in Delta Executor where you can search for the name of my script and run it.
if the script doesn't work, try copying the parts of the script that I made, just copy the parts of the loadstring to execute a script
if the script doesn't work try running this: loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Natural-Disaster-Survival-fake-lag-egor-47745"))() ...
